results.rationale: Consistency: the original two-ball composition is replaced by multiple basketballs and soccer balls in changed positions. Instruction: no basketball is resting on top of the soccer ball; duplication and rearrangement do not accomplish the requested stack. Quality: a disconnected soccer-pattern fragment at right and overlapping, ambiguous extra ball forms create multiple conspicuous structural defects.

Consistency: the plant silhouette, braided trunk and basket are retained, with minor smoothing of the basket weave detail. Instruction: the upper-left 'Green Home' title, light green glowing background, suspended water droplets and green leaf silhouettes are all clearly present. Quality: the plant, woven pot, readable script and decorative droplets form a coherent polished poster without noticeable artifacts.
